briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and Google Gemini 3 escalate frontier race as China unveils DeepSeek-R2

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The AGI race intensifies with multiple frontier releases this month. US-China compute restrictions tighten while commercial adoption accelerates across sectors.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI released o4 with advanced agentic capabilities. Anthropic launched Claude 4 Opus and Meta open-sourced Llama 4 405B variant.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and that DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level. New NIST guidelines target multi-agent risks.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA Blackwell ramp reaches 1M units shipped. Microsoft and Google announce $40B combined data center expansions in Q2.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will multi-agent security protocols like DialectForge become mandatory for all frontier deployments by 2028?
